start.title: The Road Back
start.text:
Egypt rises beyond the dust.
The land of your fear, and your call.

choices.text: Hide your face and turn back
choices.feedback: He did not send you to flee.
Each step is a vow kept.

turn_back_consequence.title: There Is No Going Back
turn_back_consequence.text:
Midian holds nothing for you now.
The call is in front, not behind.

wait_sign_consequence.title: He Has Already Spoken
wait_sign_consequence.text:
The fire on Horeb was enough.
Obey before you ask again.

meet_aaron.title: Aaron Comes to Meet You
meet_aaron.text:
Your brother runs across the sand.
"The Lord sent me to find you."

choices.feedback: He is a gift, not a rival.

test_aaron_consequence.title: He Is Your Voice
test_aaron_consequence.text:
God Himself sent him to your side.
Receive him with open arms.

tell_elders.title: Before the Elders of Israel
tell_elders.text:
Hebrew elders sit in the shadow.
They wait to hear from God.

choices.feedback: His word is not yours to edit.

soften_consequence.title: Speak It Whole
soften_consequence.text:
What He gave you, give to them.
Do not trim His word.

boast_elders_consequence.title: Not Your Glory
boast_elders_consequence.text:
It is His name that frees them.
Lower your eyes and speak.

elders_believe.title: And They Believed
elders_believe.text:
The signs are shown. The elders bow.
"The Lord has seen us at last."

palace_gates.title: Gates of Pharaoh
palace_gates.text:
Stone giants flank the entrance.
Guards watch you with cold eyes.

choices.feedback: Iron will not open this door.
God's word does not need silver.

force_consequence.title: Not by Strength
force_consequence.text:
Spears bar your way at once.
Ask, do not seize.

bribe_consequence.title: His Word, Not Coin
bribe_consequence.text:
You carry the name of the Lord.
That is gate enough.

court_official.title: The King's Servant
court_official.text:
A bald scribe blocks the way.
"State your name and your god."

choices.text: "The God of the Hebrews sent us"

choices.feedback: Hide His name and lose it.

hide_sender_consequence.title: Do Not Hide Him
hide_sender_consequence.text:
He sent you in His name.
Speak it, even here.

choices.text: "The God of the Hebrews sent us"

enter_throne_hall.title: Into the Light
enter_throne_hall.text:
A shaft of sun falls on the throne.
Pharaoh waits, still as stone.

worship_consequence.title: Bow Only to Him
worship_consequence.text:
No man wears the crown of God.
Stand and speak the truth.

run_hall_consequence.title: Do Not Flee Now
run_hall_consequence.text:
He has gone before you here.
Set your feet and speak.

before_pharaoh.title: The First Word
before_pharaoh.text:
Pharaoh's eyes weigh you in silence.
The court holds its breath.

choices.feedback: The words ring across the hall.
It is a command, not a plea.

beg_consequence.title: Speak the Lord's Word
beg_consequence.text:
Pity is not the message.
Deliverance is.

threaten_consequence.title: His Word Is Enough
threaten_consequence.text:
You have no army at your back.
You have His name on your lips.

pharaoh_mocks.title: "Who Is the Lord?"
pharaoh_mocks.text:
"I do not know your God,
and I will not let Israel go."

choices.text: Hold the word of the Lord

curse_consequence.title: Not Your Wrath
curse_consequence.text:
Judgment belongs to the Lord.
Speak only what He gave.

choices.text: Hold the word of the Lord

apologize_consequence.title: Do Not Take It Back
apologize_consequence.text:
His command stands, even here.
Repeat it, do not retract it.

choices.text: Hold the word of the Lord

demand_again.title: A Three Days' Journey
demand_again.text:
"Let us go to sacrifice in the desert,
lest plague or sword find us."

lie_consequence.title: Do Not Lie for God
lie_consequence.text:
His work needs no deceit.
Speak only what He told you.

pharaoh_refuses.title: Pharaoh's Wrath
pharaoh_refuses.text:
"You make the people idle!
Return to your burdens — now."

choices.feedback: You will not bow to him.

argue_consequence.title: His Heart Is Stone
argue_consequence.text:
Words alone will not move him.
Let the Lord answer.

flee_consequence.title: Do Not Run
flee_consequence.text:
You came as a messenger of God.
Leave standing, not fleeing.

harsher_labor.title: No More Straw
harsher_labor.text:
"Let them gather their own straw.
The quota will not be lessened."

choices.text: Carry the news to the people
Hide the new decree from them

hide_decree_consequence.title: They Must Know
hide_decree_consequence.text:
Silence will not soften the blow.
Go and speak the truth.

choices.text: Carry the news to the people

foremen_beaten.title: The Foremen Bleed
foremen_beaten.text:
Hebrew foremen are struck for failing.
Bricks lie scattered in the dust.

choices.feedback: That sin already cost you years.

hide_face_consequence.title: Do Not Look Away
hide_face_consequence.text:
Their wounds are part of the call.
Stand with them.

strike_guard_consequence.title: Not Again
strike_guard_consequence.text:
Once before you struck in rage.
This time, trust the Lord.

israelites_blame.title: "You Have Made Us Hated"
israelites_blame.text:
The foremen turn on you in grief.
"Pharaoh's sword is at our throats."

defend_consequence.title: Hear Their Pain
defend_consequence.text:
Their backs bleed for your words.
Let them speak it out.

curse_people_consequence.title: They Are Yours
curse_people_consequence.text:
These are the flock you were given.
Do not curse what He blesses.

moses_cries_out.title: Alone Before God
moses_cries_out.text:
Night falls on the brick fields.
You kneel beneath the cold stars.

choices.text: Resign and go back to Midian

choices.feedback: The burden is yours, not his.

resign_consequence.title: He Is Not Done
resign_consequence.text:
The work has barely begun.
Lift your eyes to Him.

blame_aaron_consequence.title: He Is Your Helper
blame_aaron_consequence.text:
Aaron was given to your weakness.
Do not turn on him.

choices.feedback: You bring it to God instead.

ending.title: The Lord Will Answer
ending.text:
Wind moves over the dark sand.
His hand is not yet revealed.
